source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
**Checklist for testing**
**Please verify the following in production:**

***1\. Validating referral codes***
[ACCOUNT_001] Enter an invalid code (*e.g., "5" when only 1-2 NFTs exist*) — an invalid message should appear
[ACCOUNT_001] Enter a valid code (*e.g., "1" if NFT #1 exists*) — a valid message should appear
[ACCOUNT_001] Leave the code blank — the "No/Invalid referral code" message should appear

***2\. Minting***
[ACCOUNT_001] Try minting with USDC — it should succeed
[ACCOUNT_001] Review the dashboard — it should list only successful mints

***3\. NFT details page***
[ACCOUNT_001] Open an NFT detail page — the complete book cover should be displayed
[ACCOUNT_001] If you are the owner, the "*View Book*" button should appear

***4\. Badges***
[ACCOUNT_001] Review the dashboard badges section — it should contain 8 badges (Legend removed). Keep in mind that the badge display is responsive, so it is determined by the screen size

Every fix is live and available for testing.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the live dashboard uses eight badges after removing Legend and that the badge display responds to screen size.
